rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matching to a single user before accessing or changing orders. It inspected the pending order details, asked for explicit confirmation before attempting to modify items, and when the system did not allow removing an item, it correctly explained the constraint and obtained explicit confirmation to cancel the entire order, including a stated reason, before executing the cancellation. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
